title: Adopt the expressions spec
summary: This bundle holds only replies to the vote on adopting the expressions spec; the message that opened the vote is not included, so the bundle does not show the exact text or pull request being voted on, and it has no result message either. All eight replies, sent on June 25 and 26, 2026, are +1 with no further comment. sungwy, danielcweeks, singhpk234, amogh-jahagirdar, zeroshade and kevinjqliu marked their votes binding, and jzhuge and SteveStevenpoor marked theirs non-binding. Nobody voted -1 or +0, and no concerns, questions or requested changes were raised in these replies.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. The replies show eight +1 votes: six marked binding and two marked non-binding; no -1 votes.
